en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch an action movie
Watch a comedy movie
Watch an anime movie
...Why do I have to see gore in movies, too?

Honestly, I don't get why anyone would
like that.

I don't really get comedy too well,
but better than gory movies.

At least there's no blood on the screen.
For once, it feels like I'm not at work.

Oh, yeah. 
Can you explain some of the jokes to me?

Maybe that way, I can understand why
people like comedy movies so much.
This...reminds me of my childhood.

When I was a kid, I thought I could be normal
like the girls in the anime were.

Oh, what were you like as a kid?
Did you have a strong sense of justice?

...It's easy picturing you as a child.
You must've been called cute a lot, huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Maki looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Maki's inner thoughts...?
